notes.title: Update 1.1.27 - Hard mode available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30762673/205244892fbf8d75f920f790943d9f4254432977.png[/img]

Hi, all! 

Long time no see, but we’ve been busy bees working on the hardmode.

Hardmode can be unlocked even if you haven’t finished the game and will not affect previous progress. However, if you didn’t unlock a level on normal mode, it will not be available on hardmode. It can be toggled on/off from the main menu. When enabled, save points will be deactivated and you have to collect all the QBITs. Also, you need to finish the level in the required time, otherwise it will automatically restart. 

Hope you enjoy both the challenge and the achievements!

notes.title: Update 1.1.14 - Bonus level and major performance improvements
notes.notes:
This major update’s centre piece is the bonus level, available after completing the final stage, “Victory Lap”. Performance improvement is also one of our top priorities and we are still focusing to enhance stability on lower spec systems.
So please find below a breakdown of fixes, improvements and goodies:

Features:
Bonus level - implements a better design approach, quickly raising up the challenge degree. 
In-game help - pressing F1 will pause the game and pop-up help window.  Main functional tiles names and truth tables are now within reach.
Extra in-game tips - more in game displays with hints. 
Several progression blocks solved - expands the choice range for gravity objects management.

Performance:
Fixed performance loss due to large amount of particles (levels with over 100 collectibles)
Fixed performance loss due to large levels.
Improved overall stability.
Better frame rate on low spec systems.

Art
Background tiles detail added.
Chips have now more depth.

Fixes:
Fixed texture glitch on picking up floppies (low occurrence)

We're getting back to work for the next update. Thank you for playing CompliKATed and we wish you happy brain workout!

notes.title: Version 1.0.43 released!
notes.notes:
Good news CompliKATed players! We've released version 1.0.43 which brings minor bug fixes and an improved tutorial level.

We've also added the Quickload option in the menu during gameplay for convenience!

Hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Upcoming localization
notes.notes: We're ːsteamhappyː happy to announce that coding for localization is finished and the feature will be soon implemented, as promised on the release. While we haven’t yet scheduled exact details for each language, the general plan is that at least 2 languages will be available this autumn. Additional translations will follow the initial localized release as closely as possible.
